description: Screen a person, company or ship by name against the UK Sanctions List (FCDO/OFSI), the US OFAC lists, the UN Security Council list and the EU financial sanctions list in one call. Matching tolerates transliteration and spelling variants; date of birth and country re-rank matches but never hide a name match. Returns the listed record, why it matched and which lists were checked. Covers the UK, US OFAC (SDN and Consolidated), EU and UN lists; does not cover politically exposed persons (PEPs). Use for supplier, customer and payment screening. (cost: 3 credits)

country.description: string, optional nationality or country (name, ISO code or adjective)

dob.description: string, optional date or year of birth

lists.description: comma list of uk, un, eu, ofac (default all)

name.description: string, required (or a 7-digit IMO number for a ship)

name: sanctions_screen
